This Repository

What's in the tc39-proposal branch of arv/threads, and how to work on it.

@arv/structs is the tc39-proposal branch of arv/threads. Here's what's in it:

Path What it is
src/runtime/heap.ts The heap: allocation, locks, interned strings
src/runtime/shared.ts Shared Structs and Shared Arrays: slots, shapes, Proxies
src/runtime/structs.ts What struct declarations become
src/runtime/sync.ts Mutex, UnlockToken, Condition
src/runtime/atomics.ts The Atomics overloads, Reflect.canBeShared
src/runtime/agent.ts Workers on the same heap, messages with shared objects
src/runtime/emit.ts What compiled code imports
src/compiler/scan.ts Finds struct declarations and spells them as classes
src/compiler/transform.ts Lowers them
src/compiler/project.ts TypeScript projects: type checking
src/compiler/fast.ts Direct field access where the types allow it
src/register.ts Node's load hook
playground/ The playground: edit, compile and run in the browser
site/ These docs as a site, built by Eleventy

The compiler parses with TypeScript 7's API (the same parser in both modes), edits with magic-string, and strips types with OXC.

Development

The repository is a pnpm workspace on Vite+ (vp), with the playground and these docs as packages of their own. 

pnpm install
vp check
vp test

vp check formats, lints and type checks. vp test runs the tests in test/, including workers that share the heap, and the site's own: every link of these docs leads somewhere, and every code block and table of the repository's Markdown is in them.
